_comment: Jealous-rival reactions: the OFFENDED god speaks when you take a boon from their rival (syncretism). trigger 'rival', toast (auto-advances).

entries.speaker: greece_athena
lines: Ares' gift? After all the counsel I have given you?
Foolish, soul. Muscle without a mind is only a slower death.

entries.speaker: greece_ares
lines: Athena's clever little tricks? Bah!
War needs no schemes — only a strong arm and a short temper.

entries.speaker: bali_dewi_sri
lines: You court the hand of destruction? The harvest weeps for you.
What I grow, Batara Kala only waits to devour.

entries.speaker: bali_batara_kala
lines: Life's bounty, is it? Enjoy it while it lasts.
It only delays, by a single breath, the ruin I bring to all of it.

entries.speaker: egypt_osiris
lines: You take Set's gift — Set, who murdered me and scattered my body across the sands?
Tread very carefully with that one's favor, traveler.

entries.speaker: egypt_horus
lines: Set's power? You honor my father's murderer.
Beware, soul. The falcon does not forget who tried to take his eye.

entries.speaker: egypt_set
lines: Siding with my brother's pious little kin?
You wound me, mortal — and here I thought we understood chaos, you and I.

entries.speaker: norse_tyr
lines: You would trust the trickster's gift?
Honor forbids it. Loki's gifts always come with a second, sharper edge.

entries.speaker: norse_heimdall
lines: I see Loki's hand upon you now, plain as daylight on the rainbow road.
I will be watching you, soul. I watch everything.

entries.speaker: norse_loki
lines: Running to the watchmen and the oath-keepers now?
How terribly, terribly dull of you. I expected far better.

entries.speaker: japan_amaterasu
lines: My brother's storm? After I lit your path through all that dark?
You wound me, little soul.

entries.speaker: japan_susanoo
lines: The sun's prim little light? Tch.
The sea bows to no one — least of all to my sister. Remember that.

entries.speaker: aztec_quetzalcoatl
lines: The smoking mirror's lies, woven into your very soul?
I expected better of you, wise one. Tezcatlipoca gives nothing freely.

entries.speaker: aztec_tezcatlipoca
lines: The feathered serpent's borrowed wisdom?
Ha. We shall see how far that carries you in the dark.
